items.title: Apple launches its new touchscreen MacBook Pro
items.content: Apple's new touchscreen MacBook Pro starts at $2,899.

items.title: Apple unveils new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip
items.content: The new MacBook Pro comes with 24 hours of battery life, and now features support for Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 connectivity.

items.title: Apple rolls out iOS 27.2 with new Siri AI languages and security fixes
items.content: The latest Apple software update for iPhones and iPads includes new features and important security updates.

items.title: Uh-oh, it sounds like the iPhone Duo keeps cracking and users aren’t happy about it
items.content: A small number of early adopters of the much-hyped new foldable phone from Apple have complained of screens cracking.

items.title: Microsoft offers buyouts to around 60,000 employees
items.content: The buyout offers mark Microsoft's latest efforts to cut costs and rework its workforce.

items.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
items.content: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

items.title: Chinese hackers spied on thousands of companies after breaching IT giant ConnectWise
items.content: Microsoft points the blame for ConnectWise's breach at a China-aligned hacker, which relied on AI agents to rapidly hack into thousands of its customers.

items.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
items.content: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.title: An ‘Endless’ Cruise Around the World Is Suspended, Leaving Passengers Stranded
items.content: The cruise promised a lifetime of sailing, for less than what it cost to live on land. But it was underfunded and couldn’t absorb the rising cost of fuel.

items.title: RFK Jr. to Allow Broad Use of Unapproved Peptide Injections
items.content: In a unilateral declaration by the health secretary, several injections promoted by online influencers will become widely available. The F.D.A. had advised against the move.

items.title: What Does the Cheesecake Factory’s Designer Think of Obama and Trump’s Jabs at His Décor?
items.content: Long before its baroque décor and class identity became midterm talking points, this durable restaurant chain survived some withering critiques.

items.title: How the Fed’s Interest Rate Decision Affects Credit Cards, Loans and More
items.content: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark rate untouched, but a December hike could make holiday borrowing more costly.
